Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_SolarModule: A 50 W solar module. Mount it flat, on a wall or on a ground rack.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_SolarFlat: One module lying flat, on a roof or the ground. Best in summer; snow settles on it.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_SolarWall: One module on an outside wall, facing south or east. Best in winter; snow slides off.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_SolarRack: Two modules tilted toward the sun. Sheds snow within a couple of hours.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_BatteryBox: Holds 2 batteries and an inverter. Up to 2 modules may charge it without a controller.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_BatteryBank: Holds 12 batteries, an inverter and up to 4 charge controllers.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_PlugInInverter: Runs lights, a radio or a small TV from a battery bank.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_PowerInverter: Runs a house's lights and a small fridge from a battery bank.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_InverterCharger: Runs a whole house, and charges the bank from a running backup generator.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_ChargeController: Keeps solar panels from overcharging a full battery bank.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_SolarFailsafe: Place it under a backup generator. It starts the generator when the battery bank runs low.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_DeepCycleBattery: Built to be run down and recharged. Goes in a battery bank, or in a vehicle, where it runs the lights and radio twice as long as a car battery.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_L16Battery: A heavy 6 V battery for battery banks. Too low a voltage for a vehicle.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_SolarMaintainer: Clip it to a vehicle to keep its battery charged in daylight.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_SolarCellCharger: Place it outdoors and load it with up to 4 batteries. Charges them in daylight.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_NeedSnowTool: Needs a broom or a snow shovel.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_NoBankInReach: No battery bank within reach of this panel.
Tooltip_RenewableEnergy_PanelIndoors: The panel has to be outdoors.
